description: Give the next naked-eye passes of the ISS (and Tiangong) over one of 41 French, Belgian, Swiss, UK and Irish cities, with local times, directions and a calendar feed whose alarm rings 10 minutes before each pass. Use it when the user names a city or wants an alert; for any other coordinates use iss_passes. Passes are precomputed every few hours by Vigi-Sky; with lat/lon the nearest covered city is used.

city.description: City name, e.g. Lyon, Bruxelles, Genève, London, Dublin. Omit it to use lat/lon instead.

lang.description: Language of the text fields: fr (default) or en.

lat.description: Observer latitude in decimal degrees, WGS84 (north positive).

lng.description: Observer longitude in decimal degrees, WGS84 (east positive). lon and lng are aliases: give one.

lon.description: Observer longitude in decimal degrees, WGS84 (east positive). lon and lng are aliases: give one.

name: iss_city_passes

outputSchema.description: Returns city, passes [{when, start, end, max_el, from, highest, to, duration_min}], page, calendar_ics, available.

title: ISS passes over a city
